name: WASP-4
description: Star of 5,400 K, 267 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

radius.source: Baştürk et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

mass.source: Baştürk et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

temperature.source: Bouma et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of WASP-4 b's parameter set from Bouma et al. 2019 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

text.card: WASP-4 b crosses WASP-4 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius follows Baştürk et al. 2025, and its temperature Bouma et al. 2019.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (st_refname BOUMA_ET_AL__2019, BA_AMP__351_T_AMP_UUML_RK_ET_AL__2025): st_teff 5400, st_rad 0.912, st_mass 0.899

quotes.title: WASP-4
quotes.card: WASP-4 is a G-type main-sequence star approximately 891 light-years away in the constellation of Phoenix.
quotes.introduction: Despite its advanced age, the star is rotating rapidly, being spun up by the tides raised by a giant planet on a close orbit.
